title: Priscilla Chan founded a school in 2016; 10 yrs later, it closed after $125m funding
content: The Primary School, a tuition-free institution, will close in June after a decade of operation. This school provided education, healthcare, and family support to low-income children. The Chan Zuckerberg Initiative will not continue funding beyond the upcoming academic year. Academic results remained below state averages, prompting the board's decision. The initiative pledged fifty million dollars to aid the transition for affected students.

title: EU eyes tougher border controls after Ceuta migrant surge triggers alarm
content: European Union ministers are demanding stricter measures against migrant smuggling networks.  They also seek stronger return policies following a large influx into Ceuta.  The bloc is enhancing border security and intelligence sharing with external partners.  Disinformation by smugglers fueled the unprecedented migration surge into the Spanish enclave.  This crisis has reignited divisions within the European Union over migration management.

title: Veteran actor Pradeep Rawat of 'Ghajini', 'Lagaan' fame passes away after battle with cancer
content: Renowned veteran actor Pradeep Rawat, celebrated for his iconic villain roles, has passed away at the age of seventy-four. His death occurred on the evening of August 4, 2026, as announced by his Lagaan co-star Yashpal Sharma. Rawat's remarkable contributions in both Hindi and South Indian cinema were matched only by his genuine humility and strong on-screen presence. He leaves behind a lasting legacy.

title: Lauren Sanchez worked at waterpark; 40 years later, she takes luxurious ocean trips
content: Lauren Sanchez's career evolved from a teenage waterpark job to ocean conservation leadership. She recently explored the Galápagos Islands, highlighting shark importance for marine health. The Bezos Earth Fund supports significant conservation projects in the Galápagos Marine Reserve. This funding protects vital habitats and migration routes for numerous marine species. Sanchez's work now focuses on protecting vast Pacific waters and their ecosystems.

title: British Columbia restores estuary as 60% of marsh faces loss by 2100
content: British Columbia invests $500,000 in a large-scale Cowichan Estuary restoration project. This initiative aims to strengthen watershed health and improve climate resilience for the region. The project focuses on rebuilding vital habitat for fish and wildlife populations. Indigenous stewardship is central, guiding land use and planting culturally significant species. This significant effort protects biodiversity and supports local communities dependent on the estuary.

title: Inside Jeff Bezos’ $500M property empire as Amazon crosses $3 trillion
content: Jeff Bezos has strengthened his position among the world's richest people as Amazon's soaring valuation has boosted his fortune. The e-commerce giant crossed the $3 trillion market capitalization mark on August 2 after reporting stronger-than-expected second-quarter earnings, while the company's artificial intelligence-driven cloud business further strengthened investor confidence.

title: US may raise H-1B, L-1 visa fees for large employers under DHS proposal
content: The US government plans to expand an additional visa fee. This fee currently applies to certain large employers filing H-1B and L-1 petitions. The planned change will extend this charge to visa extension requests. Qualifying employers with over fifty employees and a majority in H-1B or L-1 status will be affected. This expansion aims to fund biometric entry-exit system improvements and other government programs.

title: Pak drone spotted in Kathua amid reports of Islamabad's military build-up along border
content: A Pakistani drone was spotted over Kathua's Hiranagar sector, prompting a security search.  Security forces also conducted a large anti-terror operation in Poonch district.  An unexploded mortar shell was recovered from a house in Kathua.  These events occur amid heightened tensions along the India-Pakistan border.  India stated it will safeguard its national interests as needed.

title: Child protection panel launches inquiry into Meta over alleged child sexual abuse material ads
content: The NCPCR has initiated a formal investigation following alarming claims from a BBC report which suggested that advertisements on Meta’s platforms like Instagram were linked to the promotion of child abuse material. In response, the child rights organization has demanded clarity from Meta Platforms Inc. Furthermore, the NHRC has instructed the Delhi Police to look into these troubling assertions, as both entities scrutinize Meta's adherence to child protection regulations.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey from poverty to football greatness
content: Cristiano Ronaldo’s journey is about much more than football. From growing up in poverty and leaving home at 12 to losing his father before achieving global success, every challenge shaped the player he became. His story reminds people that discipline, sacrifice and love for family can help overcome even the hardest moments and turn dreams into reality.

He signed a one-day contract, met quarterback Bryce Young, joined team activities and scored a touchdown during Fan Fest, giving his family a joyful milestone after years of medical challenges.

Stokes praised Stephen Fleming as the new Test coach and wished Root success.

content: An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi encountered severe turbulence on Tuesday morning. The aircraft briefly lost altitude, causing injuries to 17 passengers and crew members. One cabin crew member sustained severe injuries, while others had minor wounds. Passengers described the terrifying ordeal, with some being thrown from their seats. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation has launched a thorough investigation into the incident.

title: Will Nifty & Sensex continue to diverge? What new stock market timings mean

title: 54 bank fraud accused fled India, ED seizes assets worth over Rs 35,000 crore

Proceedings under the Fugitive Economic Offenders Act have been launched against 27 individuals.  Assets worth over Rs 840 crore have been confiscated after nine were declared offenders.  Unclaimed bank deposits transferred to the RBI fund total Rs 62,683.19 crore.  India's foreign exchange reserves remain comfortable, covering 10.3 months of goods imports.

title: Odisha’s Pucca Ghar Yojana (Mining): Eligibility, process, purpose explained
content: Odisha's Pucca Ghar Yojana is designed to provide durable housing solutions for eligible kutcha households. The initiative focuses on 36 blocks within nine mineral-rich districts impacted by mining. Beneficiaries will receive financial aid for construction, along with assistance for essential services like toilets. To determine eligibility, thorough surveys and checks against existing housing schemes are conducted, with registration available online or via local government officials.

title: ‘Respectful language should still be maintained’: Ex-India captain on abuse against PM Modi

Manu Bhaker also urged youngsters to use respectful words. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, meanwhile, said he did not want the protesters punished, calling their actions mistakes and hoping they would learn from them.

title: From apps to 'intent': How AI agents will rewrite the way we use next‑gen phones
content: Smartphones are set to abandon their traditional app icon grids in favor of AI-driven interfaces. Instead of manually opening apps, users will communicate their intentions via voice or text to smart agents that handle tasks seamlessly. This groundbreaking shift heralds a new age of technology, where app stores could evolve into dynamic service registries for these advanced AI agents.

title: Student housing is India's next real estate hotspot, says report - here's why
content: The surge in India's higher education landscape is driving a notable increase in demand for student accommodation. With international universities thriving and overseas education expenses rising, a remarkable demographic shift is anticipated, projecting over 70 million students by 2035. This educational migration will generate massive housing needs, prompting a significant boost in institutional investments aimed at nationwide accommodation development.

title: India paves way for return of merchant fees on UPI; what it means
content: Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is the fee merchants pay to banks and payment service providers for processing digital transactions. In India, credit card payments generally attract an MDR of around 1.5%.

title: Scientists discover Greenland sharks can see for centuries, debunking blindness myth
content: Recent studies reveal that Greenland sharks possess well-preserved visual systems that can last for centuries, challenging the previous notion that they were nearly blind. Research shows that their eyes are uniquely suited for low-light environments, demonstrating impressive adaptability. Scientists found healthy rod cells and active genes responsible for light detection, indicating these sharks have a remarkable ability to maintain their eyesight throughout their extended lifespans.
